Confirm flashlight_profiles.py no longer sends string/enum candidates such as Enabled through SPEAR reflected method/property calls. Check tests added for unsupported RT, false readback, confirmed readback, and bool-only candidate strategy. Rerun python -m unittest tests.test_orbit_collection_validation and py_compile for changed files. Return whether user can rerun the same command and what to expect about hardware RT on VULKAN_SM5.
expected_outputs: Pass/block review result for rerunning realistic live cafeteria after RT unsupported crash.
definition_of_done: No blocker remains for retrying the user command, or any blocker is explicitly reported with file/line evidence.
